  <section id="features" aria-labelledby="features-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="features-title">What Nano Banana Pro Is Built For</h2>
        <p>The option you pick when the image has to be right the first time.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="bento">
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="monitor-play" class="lucide lucide-monitor-play"><path d="M10 7.75a.75.75 0 0 1 1.142-.638l3.664 2.249a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.278l-3.664 2.25a.75.75 0 0 1-1.142-.64z"></path><path d="M12 17v4"></path><path d="M8 21h8"></path><rect x="2" y="3" width="20" height="14" rx="2"></rect></svg></div>
          <h3>4K Resolution Output</h3>
          <p>Generate at <strong>4K natively</strong> rather than upscaling afterwards, so fine texture survives across the whole frame.</p>
          <div class="asset-stats" aria-hidden="true">
            <div><b>4K</b><span>Native</span></div>
            <div><b>PNG</b><span>Export</span></div>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="message-square" class="lucide lucide-message-square"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path></svg></div>
          <h3>Natural Language Editing</h3>
          <p>Attach an image and describe the change — swap a season, replace a background, restyle a subject — <strong>without a brush or a mask</strong>.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="message-square" class="lucide lucide-message-square"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path></svg>Say it</span>
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="check" class="lucide lucide-check"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg>No masking</span>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="repeat" class="lucide lucide-repeat"><path d="m17 2 4 4-4 4"></path><path d="M3 11v-1a4 4 0 0 1 4-4h14"></path><path d="m7 22-4-4 4-4"></path><path d="M21 13v1a4 4 0 0 1-4 4H3"></path></svg></div>
          <h3>Character Consistency</h3>
          <p>Hold the same character across a set of images, which is what makes a series or a storyboard usable rather than a collection of near-misses.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="repeat" class="lucide lucide-repeat"><path d="m17 2 4 4-4 4"></path><path d="M3 11v-1a4 4 0 0 1 4-4h14"></path><path d="m7 22-4-4 4-4"></path><path d="M21 13v1a4 4 0 0 1-4 4H3"></path></svg>Across images</span>
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="users" class="lucide lucide-users"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"></circle><path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"></path><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"></path></svg>Series</span>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="palette" class="lucide lucide-palette"><circle cx="13.5" cy="6.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><circle cx="17.5" cy="10.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><circle cx="8.5" cy="7.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><circle cx="6.5" cy="12.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><path d="M12 2C6.5 2 2 6.5 2 12s4.5 10 10 10c.926 0 1.648-.746 1.648-1.688 0-.437-.18-.835-.437-1.125-.29-.289-.438-.652-.438-1.125a1.64 1.64 0 0 1 1.668-1.668h1.996c3.051 0 5.555-2.503 5.555-5.554C21.965 6.012 17.461 2 12 2z"></path></svg></div>
          <h3>Multi-Style Generation</h3>
          <p>Photoreal, 3D render, illustration, pop-art — the style is a clause, and the model holds the composition steady while it changes.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="palette" class="lucide lucide-palette"><circle cx="13.5" cy="6.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><circle cx="17.5" cy="10.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><circle cx="8.5" cy="7.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><circle cx="6.5" cy="12.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle><path d="M12 2C6.5 2 2 6.5 2 12s4.5 10 10 10c.926 0 1.648-.746 1.648-1.688 0-.437-.18-.835-.437-1.125-.29-.289-.438-.652-.438-1.125a1.64 1.64 0 0 1 1.668-1.668h1.996c3.051 0 5.555-2.503 5.555-5.554C21.965 6.012 17.461 2 12 2z"></path></svg>Photoreal</span>
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="box" class="lucide lucide-box"><path d="M21 8a2 2 0 0 0-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 0 0 3 8v8a2 2 0 0 0 1 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 0 0 2 0l7-4A2 2 0 0 0 21 16Z"></path><path d="m3.3 7 8.7 5 8.7-5"></path><path d="M12 22V12"></path></svg>3D</span>
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="sparkles" class="lucide lucide-sparkles"><path d="M9.937 15.5A2 2 0 0 0 8.5 14.063l-6.135-1.582a.5.5 0 0 1 0-.962L8.5 9.936A2 2 0 0 0 9.937 8.5l1.582-6.135a.5.5 0 0 1 .963 0L14.063 8.5A2 2 0 0 0 15.5 9.937l6.135 1.581a.5.5 0 0 1 0 .964L15.5 14.063a2 2 0 0 0-1.437 1.437l-1.582 6.135a.5.5 0 0 1-.963 0z"></path><path d="M20 3v4"></path><path d="M22 5h-4"></path><path d="M4 17v2"></path><path d="M5 18H3"></path></svg>Illustration</span>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="zap" class="lucide lucide-zap"><path d="M4 14a1 1 0 0 1-.78-1.63l9.9-10.2a.5.5 0 0 1 .86.46l-1.92 6.02A1 1 0 0 0 13 10h7a1 1 0 0 1 .78 1.63l-9.9 10.2a.5.5 0 0 1-.86-.46l1.92-6.02A1 1 0 0 0 11 14z"></path></svg></div>
          <h3>Fast for Its Tier</h3>
          <p>Quick enough to iterate at the top quality tier, so you are not choosing between speed and the result you actually want.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="timer" class="lucide lucide-timer"><line x1="10" x2="14" y1="2" y2="2"></line><line x1="12" x2="15" y1="14" y2="11"></line><circle cx="12" cy="14" r="8"></circle></svg>Quick</span>
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="git-branch" class="lucide lucide-git-branch"><line x1="6" x2="6" y1="3" y2="15"></line><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"></circle><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"></circle><path d="M18 9a9 9 0 0 1-9 9"></path></svg>Iterate</span>
          </div>
        </article>
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="brain-circuit" class="lucide lucide-brain-circuit"><path d="M12 5a3 3 0 1 0-5.997.125 4 4 0 0 0-2.526 5.77 4 4 0 0 0 .556 6.588A4 4 0 1 0 12 18Z"></path><path d="M9 13a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 3-4"></path><path d="M6.003 5.125A3 3 0 0 0 6.401 6.5"></path><path d="M3.477 10.896a4 4 0 0 1 .585-.396"></path><path d="M6 18a4 4 0 0 1-1.967-.516"></path><path d="M12 13h4"></path><path d="M12 18h6a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path><path d="M12 8h8"></path><path d="M16 8V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2"></path><circle cx="16" cy="13" r=".5"></circle><circle cx="18" cy="3" r=".5"></circle><circle cx="20" cy="21" r=".5"></circle><circle cx="20" cy="8" r=".5"></circle></svg></div>
          <h3>Advanced Image Reasoning</h3>
          <p>Reads and reproduces <strong>charts, equations and dense document text</strong> accurately — the class of task that defeats most image models.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">
            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="bar-chart-3" class="lucide lucide-bar-chart-3"><path d="M3 3v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16"></path><path d="M18 17V9"></path><path d="M13 17V5"></path><path d="M8 17v-3"></path></svg>Charts</span>

        <h2 id="examples-title">Rendered with Nano Banana Pro</h2>
        <p>Six outputs with the prompt behind each — photoreal composite, light study, product art, 4K detail, instruction editing and style transfer.</p>

      <div class="example-grid two" aria-label="Nano Banana Pro examples">
          <figure class="prompt-card reveal">
            <img src="https://cdn.hailuoai.video/open-hailuo-video-web/public_assets/7f311d15-5779-4c2a-882b-15a3442fdcc0.jpg?x-oss-process=image/format,webp" alt="Nano Banana Pro photorealistic composite example" width="1376" height="768" loading="lazy" decoding="async">

  </section>
  <section id="chooser" aria-labelledby="chooser-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="chooser-title">Pro or Nano Banana 2? Pick by the Job</h2>
        <p>Both sit next to each other in the model picker, and the editor describes them plainly: Pro is the peak-capability option, <a href='https://hailuoai.video/tools/nano-banana-2' style='color:var(--hl-brand-01)'>Nano Banana 2</a> is the faster, more affordable one. Neither is the &ldquo;better&rdquo; model &mdash; they answer different constraints.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="chooser">
        <figure class="step-media reveal">
          <span class="chrome" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><b>hailuoai.video/create/image-generation</b><span class="chrome-tag"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="badge-check" class="lucide lucide-badge-check"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Real Hailuo AI editor</span></span>
          <span class="shot" style="aspect-ratio:368/156"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Hailuo AI image model picker showing Nano Banana Pro highlighted directly above Nano Banana 2" width="736" height="312" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
        </figure>
        <div class="pick-cards">
          <article class="pick-card reveal">
            <h3><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="crown" class="lucide lucide-crown"><path d="M11.562 3.266a.5.5 0 0 1 .876 0L15.39 8.87a1 1 0 0 0 1.516.294L21.183 5.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .798.519l-2.834 10.246a1 1 0 0 1-.956.734H5.81a1 1 0 0 1-.957-.734L2.02 6.02a.5.5 0 0 1 .798-.519l4.276 3.664a1 1 0 0 0 1.516-.294z"></path><path d="M5 21h14"></path></svg>Choose Nano Banana Pro</h3>
            <p>Latest model, peak performance, unmatched capabilities.</p>
            <ul><li>The image is the deliverable, not a draft</li><li>You want maximum detail and fidelity in one pass</li><li>Complex scenes with many elements to hold together</li><li>Reasoning-heavy asks: charts, diagrams, dense text in frame</li></ul>
          </article>
          <article class="pick-card reveal">
            <h3><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="zap" class="lucide lucide-zap"><path d="M4 14a1 1 0 0 1-.78-1.63l9.9-10.2a.5.5 0 0 1 .86.46l-1.92 6.02A1 1 0 0 0 13 10h7a1 1 0 0 1 .78 1.63l-9.9 10.2a.5.5 0 0 1-.86-.46l1.92-6.02A1 1 0 0 0 11 14z"></path></svg>Choose Nano Banana 2</h3>
            <p>More affordable, faster speeds, and exceptional performance.</p>
            <ul><li>You are exploring and will generate dozens</li><li>Cost per image matters more than the last 5% of quality</li><li>Turnaround speed is the constraint</li><li>Volume work like thumbnails and social variants</li></ul>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="how-to" aria-labelledby="howto-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="howto-title">How to Use Nano Banana Pro</h2>
        <p>Four steps in the Hailuo AI image editor.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="stepper">
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">1</span><h3>Select Nano Banana Pro</h3></div>
            <p>Open the model picker and choose <strong>Nano Banana Pro</strong> — the editor lists it as the latest model with peak performance.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">2</span><h3>Upload or Describe</h3></div>
            <p>Start from a written description, or attach an image and describe the change you want made to it.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">3</span><h3>Set 4K and the Top Quality Tier</h3></div>
            <p>For a deliverable, raise both resolution and quality. For exploration, drop them — the prompt behaviour stays the same.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">4</span><h3>Generate &amp; Download</h3></div>
            <p>Review at full size, refine one clause if a detail is off, and export the final image.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="faq-title">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
        <p>What people ask about the Pro tier.</p>
      </div>
      <p class="faq-kicker reveal"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="crown" class="lucide lucide-crown"><path d="M11.562 3.266a.5.5 0 0 1 .876 0L15.39 8.87a1 1 0 0 0 1.516.294L21.183 5.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .798.519l-2.834 10.246a1 1 0 0 1-.956.734H5.81a1 1 0 0 1-.957-.734L2.02 6.02a.5.5 0 0 1 .798-.519l4.276 3.664a1 1 0 0 0 1.516-.294z"></path><path d="M5 21h14"></path></svg>Capability</p>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item reveal" open>
          <summary>What makes Nano Banana Pro different from other image models?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Three things: <strong>native 4K output</strong>, editing driven by natural-language instructions rather than masks, and enough visual reasoning to handle charts, equations and dense document text that most image models garble.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>What editing can it do?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Style transformation, background replacement or removal, object-level changes and subject restyling — all described in words and applied to an image you attach as a reference.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>What resolutions does it support?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Up to <strong>4K</strong>, with multiple aspect ratios covering square, portrait and landscape. Resolution and quality are separate controls in the editor.</p></div>
        </details>
      </div>
      <p class="faq-kicker reveal"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="git-compare" class="lucide lucide-git-compare"><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="3"></circle><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"></circle><path d="M13 6h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v7"></path><path d="M11 18H8a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V9"></path></svg>Choosing &amp; Access</p>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>Should I use Pro or Nano Banana 2?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Pick <strong>Pro</strong> when the image is the deliverable and you want maximum fidelity in one pass. Pick <a href='https://hailuoai.video/tools/nano-banana-2' style='color:var(--hl-brand-01)'>Nano Banana 2</a> when you are exploring, generating in volume, or speed and cost matter more than the last few percent of quality.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>Is it free to use?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Hailuo AI offers trial access and periodic free credits; beyond that, generations draw on your plan. Check the banner on hailuoai.video for the current offer.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>Can I use the images commercially?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Commercial use follows your plan and the <a href='https://intl.minimaxi.com/protocol?id=hailuo-user-agreement' rel='noopener'>Hailuo AI Terms of Use</a>. Review them before publishing generated images as business assets.</p></div>
        </details>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-more reveal">
        <span>Still have questions?</span>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="https://discord.com/invite/hvvt8hAye6">Join the Discord<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="arrow-right" class="lucide lucide-arrow-right"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"></path></svg></a>

        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="https://sixth-switch-2ac.notion.site/Hailuo-AI-prompt-library-1446c20a98eb80bb9bcec26eb1ad1854">Prompt Library<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="arrow-right" class="lucide lucide-arrow-right"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"></path></svg></a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
